display_name: Impulse Efficiency S2 (H1 Z_t/ER_t | SL 0.50% / TP 3.00%)

logic.summary: H1 directional impulse continuation gate (|Z_t(3)| >= 2.0 vs pre-move 20-bar RMS volatility, ER_t(3) >= 0.75) with convex tail-runner SL 0.50% / TP 3.00% of entry price (1:6 R:R).
logic.economic_rationale: Pairs tight invalidation (0.50%) with wide asymmetric upside (3.00%) to capture right-tail regime breakouts following clean high-Z impulse bars.
known_assumptions: Pre-move volatility uses bars [k .. k+W] strictly before the impulse window to prevent self-scaling lookahead.
Concurrent stop-out correlation with impulse_efficiency_s1 is high when both share identical entry triggers; portfolio sizing must account for combined drawdown.
rejection_criteria: Realized Out-of-Sample win rate falls below break-even threshold (~14.3% before costs, higher after spread/swap).
Profit relies exclusively on 1-2 outlier trades without cross-regime repeatability.
